review_scope: Independent read-only review of the three bounded B8 native-AR control files.

review_basis.full_review: The prior source version was reviewed end to end against the agreed checklist: frozen B8 import and checkpoint path, native causal AR crystal-body binding, original text/header route, 750-tensor and 8-case gates, strict END/PAD parsing with raw CrystalBlockError, all-heldout runtime override, snapshot hashes, summary metadata, and non-overwriting output path.
review_basis.follow_up: After the review finding, re-read annotate_summary and confirmed sampling.pop('block_size') removes the diffusion block-size field from AR sampling metadata. The B8 value remains in model/cohort configuration metadata.
review_basis.cpu_validation: Root-reported CPU contract validation passed after the new regression assertion was first observed failing before the metadata fix.

remaining_boundary: This review covers implementation correctness and CPU contract only; it does not report a GPU run or learned-model result.
